$schema.description: Where the JSON Schema of this file is, for the editor.

theme.description: The id of the theme, such as "noren-dusk". "system", or no value, follows the light or dark scheme of the system. An id Noren does not have also follows the system.

position.description: Which side of the window the sidebar is on.

width.description: Width of the sidebar in pixels.

compact.description: Compact mode: the sidebar leaves the layout and shows over it when the pointer touches the edge of the window.

keepOpen.description: In compact mode, keeps the sidebar open instead of hiding it.

density.description: How much room the rows of the sidebar take.

tabs.description: Where the tabs are: the tree in the sidebar, or a bar above the terminal.

paneHeaders.description: Shows a header with the title and the buttons on every pane of a tab.

appearance.description: How the window looks and is laid out.

mods.description: The CSS files of the mods folder (next to this file) that are turned on for every space, as file names such as "compact-tabs.css", in the order they are applied: the last one wins. A file that is not in the folder is ignored.

id.description: The id of the profile, such as "dev-shell". Unique among the profiles.

name.description: The name shown in the command palette.

program.description: The program that starts the shell, such as "pwsh.exe" or a full path. %NAME% is replaced by the environment variable NAME when a session starts.

args.description: The arguments of the program, one item each.

cwd.description: The folder a session of this profile starts in, unless the space or the tab names one. %NAME% is replaced by the environment variable NAME.

items.description: A shell profile of your own.

profiles.description: Shell profiles of your own, listed in the command palette after the ones Noren finds on the machine. An id the machine already has is refused when the profiles are loaded.

preset.description: Which set of shortcuts is in force: safe keeps the keys a shell uses, browser takes the keys of a web browser.

enabled.description: Off: Noren never asks the system to show a notification.

longCommandSeconds.description: A command that runs longer than this many seconds notifies when it ends out of sight.

title: Noren settings
description: The settings file of Noren (config.jsonc). Every setting is optional.
